Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

disperseR 0.1.0

  • Initial CRAN submission.
  • Workflow to classify movement phases: divide.track.by.gap(), resample.ctmm(), fitHMM.wrap(), get.epsilon(), get.arp(), link.arp(), class.mov() and transfer.disperseR().
  • Plots: draw.step.densities(), draw.linked.clusters(), draw.track() and draw.timeline().
  • phase.summary() builds a table with one row per movement phase, and print() gives a short summary of disperseR objects.
  • Simulated example data: sim_tracks and sim_states.
  • Vignette vignette("disperseR"): full workflow and sensitivity of the classification to the main arguments.

Developed by Cesar Herraiz.
